info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Status API provides users with real-time information on the status of various weather alerts. Designed for developers in the meteorological and emergency preparedness sectors, this API allows consumers to monitor and respond to weather conditions effectively. By accessing the alerts status, users can make informed decisions regarding safety and planning. Typical use cases include integrating alert statuses into applications for public safety, education, and civic services.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of alerts.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of alerts in the system. You can use this information to monitor active alerts or diagnose any issues.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the status of alerts. This should be in JSON format, specifying any necessary parameters required to assess the current state of alerts.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of alerts.
